data.title: bn-1csq: trim retained-ancestor identity to substitution-stable fields
data.description: frozen_recheck compared full stat identity (incl nlink/size/mtime/ctime) for every ANCESTOR DIRECTORY up through shared parents (~/.cache), so it fail-stopped mid-run on unrelated sibling churn ('semantic manifest ancestor changed while retained') - first run to reach frozen_recheck. _semantic_directory_identity now returns substitution-stable fields only (dev/ino/mode/uid/gid), which still detect symlink/bind/rename-to-different-inode/inode-replacement and mode/owner tamper; the manifest FILE keeps content-hash + single-link identity. The 3 hostile tests asserting same-inode rename-and-back is rejected exercised only the removed churn fields (rename-and-back to identical inode+content is not a substitution); they now assert tolerance. Real substitution stays rejected via ancestor_symlink_swap_rejected (O_NOFOLLOW) and path_swap_during_recheck_rejected (content). Deliberate trim of agent-authored over-strict custody per repo owner. Self-tests: runner 163/163, semantic-authority PASS, verifier 187/187. Commit 3082fec.
